organization: Federal Supreme Court of Switzerland (Bundesgericht / Tribunal fédéral)
description: His Federal Supreme Court biography lists him as a deputy (part-time) judge of the Court from 2020 and records his election as a federal judge by the United Federal Assembly on 23 September 2020. In 2023 he sat on a panel of the Second Criminal Law Division (cases 7B_15/2021 and 7B_16/2021, see polemics). As of October 2026 the Court's roster lists him as President of the First Civil Law Division (président de la première Cour de droit civil); the start date of that presidency is not given. The biography also lists him as a titular professor (Titularprofessor) at the University of Zurich, without a start date.
